passages.text:
Re: USAID-Meta Coordination
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Brian Rice Monday, May 2, 2022 at 10:13:26 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Sabeen Dhanani, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Catherine Eng, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Becky Moore
Cc: [contact omitted] Christopher Burns, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [contact omitted] John O'Bryan,
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Sandra Luff
Hi Sabeen—apologies for not getting back to you sooner. We are going through a bit of transition on my
team and I expect to have someone to cover Payton's role here shortly, but for now you can tag me as point
of contact and we'll come back to update.
From: Sabeen Dhanani <[contact omitted]>
Date: Tuesday, April 26, 2022 at 11:01 PM
To: Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Catherine Eng [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Becky Moore
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Christopher Burns <[contact omitted]>, Johnny Walsh <[contact omitted]>, John O'Bryan
<[contact omitted]>
Subject: USAID-Meta Coordination
Dear Brian,
I hope you're doing well. As I'm sure you are aware, there are an increasing number of conversations
between USAID and Meta, including the onethis week with the Administrator and Nick Clegg.
Previously, Payton Iheme had been our main PoC, but my understanding is that she is no longer with
Meta. Therefore, I was hoping you could help us identify a new PoC for USAID. This would obviously not
preclude sector or region specific conversations that will continue to take place (and are encouraged).
Instead, it would help us take stock of the wider USAID-Meta relationship on a regular basis and connect
the various field teams with their appropriate counterparts.
Please let me know if this is of interest and if you have any questions or concerns.
Thanks,
Sabeen
--
Sabeen V. Dhanani, (she/her)
Deputy Director, Technology Division
Innovation, Technology & Research Hub (ITR)
USAID | Development, Democracy, and Innovation
[contact omitted] |USAID.gov
